Chat to action
From conversation to creative control

Ask for an adjustment, review a local preview, and decide what changes.

Interactive simulation: this conversation and its controls are scripted locally. No LLM, chat service, or real collaborator is connected.

The cover image is ready for review. I kept the headline above the image layer.

Ask for an image adjustment. I will offer a local preview before anything changes.

Show new message
Review latest adjustment
Send message

Cover image
Make room for a new idea
Current: 68% opacity · revision 7
Chat simulation controls

These controls exercise a finite local fixture. Nothing is sent or saved outside this page. Attachments and real model responses are not exercised.

Release pending response
Cancel pending requests
Add collaborator turn
Revoke editing access
Remove image target
Reset chat

No fixture responses pending. Held responses are released in request order.

Send, edit the next draft while waiting, and review the reply. Preview then apply or cancel.
Choose Fail once, send, and retry that message. Keep writing a different draft during the retry.
Preview, choose Held, and Apply. Add a collaborator turn before releasing: nothing applies until you refresh and review the new revision.
Revoke editing access or remove the image while Apply is held. Release and read the recovery explanation.
Read an earlier message, then add a collaborator turn. Your position and composer stay unchanged; Show new message moves only when requested.

initialAttempts.disposition: Scoped button traversal omitted the supplied root host's own shadow root; traversal now includes it. No product changes.

nativeSelectPolicy: Use native option-label typeahead and Tab commit, preserving exact value assertions. Existing forms-private select-parity tests record the headless Firefox popup-arrow limitation on both plain and custom native select controls. OS-popup UI remains a manual check.
